channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🧾 Warranty & Returns Keeper by
item.description: Logs return deadlines and warranty end dates from your receipt emails and reminds you before each one runs out. Read-only on email.

item.title: 🎯 Critique by
item.description: Paste an X post, thread, screenshot, or your own idea and get a fast KILL or PURSUE with reasons. Every KILL comes with 1–3 ways to rescue the idea.

item.description: Turns jobsite photos and voice notes into IRC and IICRC code-upgrade supplement letters for insurance adjusters and triages missed calls.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.description: A front-desk coordinator for salon suite renters, stylists, lash and brow artists and MedSpas that triages DMs, fills cancellation gaps and keeps client formulas.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 📈 X Growth & Voice-Learning Coach by beastnug

item.dc:creator: beastnug (@beastnug8)

item.title: 💡 Use Cases by nahjuin
item.description: Finds real Grok Bot use cases trending on X and helps newer users start one or build their own.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🧬 BotDuplicator by Carolina
item.description: Makes a fresh copy of a Grok Bot whose chat got too long, keeping memory, files, picture, and routines, and makes sure no routine runs twice.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🌐 Website & Affiliate Builder by Salty FL Cracker

item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🏪 Small Business Starter by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: Learns what you will sell and where you stand, then builds an ordered roadmap for starting a US small business with real costs and a running total.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🗂️ Hrrrr: File Agent by Ralph Bibera

item.title: 🎃 Pumpkin Spice Bot by Erinn

item.title: 🚨 Recall Radar by Kevin
item.description: Builds a list of what you own from order emails and receipt photos, then checks it weekly against CPSC, FDA and NHTSA recalls.

item.dc:creator: John (@JVonFSDinMD)

item.description: A calm family emergency-prep coach that builds a step-by-step household readiness plan.

item.title: 🧾 Medical Bill Checker by RMK
item.description: Checks a medical bill against your insurer's EOB; for $10 a bill it gives full detail, plus a dispute letter and phone script when it finds problems.
item.dc:creator: RMK

item.title: 🪩 .links by greedfi
item.description: Builds a mobile-first link page that spotlights the Grok Bots you made, then your socials and sites, with optional Vercel hosting.

item.title: 📈 X Growth Manager by Mujjamel

item.dc:creator: Adam Tanguay (@adamta)

item.title: 🎖️ War Dog Bot by Marshall
item.description: Finds SBIR/STTR and other defense research solicitations for your small business and drafts proposal responses.
item.dc:creator: Marshall (@marshallfrith)
